entities.summary: Harald Nugiseks was an Estonian serviceman in the Waffen-SS of Nazi Germany during World War II. A Waffen-Oberscharführer (sergeant), he served in the 20th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS. Nugiseks was one of the four Estonians to receive the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross.
